proposed_claim: EBV infection and HLA-DR15 are major converging risk factors for MS, motivating DR15-restricted antigen-presentation studies.
allowed_wording: EBV and HLA-DR15 provide a biologically grounded context for studying class-II EBV and CNS antigen presentation.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim this project proves EBV causes MS.

proposed_claim: Recent evidence shows EBV-infected B cells can alter the HLA-DR15 immunopeptidome and present MBP peptides also detected in MS brain tissue.
allowed_wording: Recent immunopeptidome work supports a mechanism in which EBV infection changes DR15-restricted myelin peptide presentation.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not imply those samples are reanalyzed in this project unless the data are independently downloaded and processed.

proposed_claim: The BALF5--MBP pair is an established DR15 molecular-mimicry positive control involving DR2a and DR2b allele-pair switching.
allowed_wording: The BALF5--MBP system is used here as an experimental positive-control anchor for computational calibration.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim discovery of BALF5--MBP mimicry or describe both arms as DRB1*15:01.

proposed_claim: Experimental 1H15 and 1BX2 pMHC structures show close peptide-core geometric equivalence after HLA-groove superposition.
allowed_wording: After HLA-groove fitting, the seven-position experimental BALF5/MBP core has a C-alpha RMSD of 0.838 A.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not convert C-alpha RMSD into TCR affinity or activation evidence.

proposed_claim: All 86 rank-1 pMHC models passed peptide-sequence and three-chain layout QA.
allowed_wording: The modeled pMHC input set passed predefined peptide and chain-layout QA before structural triage.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not imply predicted structures are experimental pMHCs.

proposed_claim: The corrected pMHC screen prioritizes BALF5-family EBV candidates against MBP/myelin candidates by local peptide geometry and physicochemical similarity.
allowed_wording: The corrected pMHC screen prioritizes BALF5-family pairs as computational candidates requiring external validation.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim TCR cross-reactivity or patient relevance from the screen alone.
next_action: Turn into Figure 2 with null/decoy context.

proposed_claim: The Ob.1A12 five-chain ternary ColabFold screen failed calibration because it did not recover the known positive-control TCR orientation.
allowed_wording: The ternary screen was considered inconclusive after failing the experimental positive-control orientation benchmark.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not report ipTM or contact counts as evidence of selective EBV recognition.
next_action: Use as methodological limitation and rigor point.

proposed_claim: GSE190847 B-cell expression analysis did not show a significant HLA-II/APC module difference after correction.
allowed_wording: A peripheral B-cell expression dataset provided contextual negative evidence, not direct antigen-presentation evidence.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not use GSE190847 to validate pMHC presentation or EBV infection status.

proposed_claim: A bounded PyTorch linear probe on the seven-gene HLA-II/APC panel showed suggestive but not definitive PPMS versus healthy-control signal.
allowed_wording: The PyTorch expression classifier is reported as transcriptomic context only, with LOOCV AUC and permutation p value.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not treat the classifier as validation of EBV infection, pMHC presentation, TCR binding, activation, or MS mechanism.
next_action: Decide whether to include as Figure 4 or supplement.

proposed_claim: External validation overlay showed strong recovery of classic BALF5--MBP positive-control pairs but not broad enrichment of newer EBV glycoprotein antigen-presentation positives.
allowed_wording: The pMHC priority metric recovers the classic structural mimicry layer while showing limited recovery of newer non-mimicry antigen-presentation positives.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim all EBV--MS mechanisms are captured by the pMHC surface metric.
next_action: Use as a central validation and scope-boundary result.

proposed_claim: Exact Hy.2E11 alpha/beta sequences are not available from the checked public primary sources.
allowed_wording: Because complete Hy.2E11 receptor sequences were not available, no inferred Hy.2E11 ternary model was treated as evidence.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not reconstruct Hy.2E11 from partial V-region annotations and call it primary evidence.
next_action: List as decisive future experimental/computational requirement.

proposed_claim: The project is currently a reproducible prioritization workflow, not a standalone proof of molecular mimicry in patients.
allowed_wording: The final claim is a calibrated computational prioritization workflow anchored to known experimental positives.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim causal mechanism, affinity, activation, or patient-level pathogenicity from modeling alone.
